fable.rjd3: 'fabletools' Interface to JDemetra+ v3 Seasonal Adjustment

Source: R/fablejd3-package.R
fable.rjd3-package.Rd

Seasonal adjustment of tsibble series with X-13ARIMA (X13()) and TRAMO-SEATS (TRAMOSEATS()), and their pre-adjustment models Reg-ARIMA (REGARIMA()) and TRAMO (TRAMO()), using the JDemetra+ v3 R packages rjd3x13 and rjd3tramoseats. JDemetra+ workspaces can be imported and exported with import_jws() and export_jws().

Details

Models store the underlying Java object, so any indicator available in JDemetra+ can be extracted with jd3_indicator() and listed with jd3_dictionary(). The usual fabletools verbs work on the fitted mable: components(), glance(), tidy() and report(), as well as forecast(), backcast() and outliers().
